publication_contract.layout: ELF-derived experiment_layout table_offset and installer_end_offset; immutable runtime vector must equal manifest records

qualification_status: Twenty-hook lifecycle with develop job4, record notification and clear-record release qualifies in 26 conditional native original/owned comparisons, 20 returned memory-defect controls, two owned-only record-specific wake cases and one rejected stock unchecked-wake control (private-data/scratch/JpegJob4Quiescence/inputs/wake-native/result.json), plus installation with complete 40-word rollback. Guarded preparation/PLAY with independent-stock source/output/PNG equality was observed on the artifact before the record-specific wait and has not been repeated. Natural preparation observed job4, builder, acquire, IRQ, notification, release and clear-record release; natural PLAY observed initializer/reset/submit/prefix/timer-cancel/cancel; second completion/restart/finish remain conditional native coverage. Historical two/six/eight/seventeen-hook artifacts and receipts remain readable. Constructor serialization on task 0xb is a byte-level fact in consumer_ordering.lifetime. No physical acceptance, quiescence, retirement or unload claim.

observation_boundary.guard: Every owned original body from entry+8 through end is fetch-excluded; owned release observations are immutable interior ELF labels, not callable replacement entries.

consumer_ordering.builder: Publish the record before request fields and before lock9 acquisition. Preserve default/7/8 selector mapping, packing byte equal-to-one and untouched fields. Call the existing owned acquire directly.
consumer_ordering.first_completion: Enter nested critical; require both subscribers; clear the first subscriber; leave with the saved critical state; invoke the saved callback. Nested completion sees the cleared slot.
consumer_ordering.develop_job4: Null plane returns 0 with no effects. Otherwise fill plane +0x20/+0x24 (only when zero)/+0x28/+0x2c/+0x30, then the develop record fields in source order with completion callback 0x00e8eb18, publish the frame task with bit 31 set and call the owned builder. Wait for current-task event 0x10 with an infinite deadline until the record notification has cleared bit 31; after a wake that leaves it set, clear only event 0x10 of the current task through 0x007246f0, recheck, and wait again. Then call owned clear-record release and return 8 when record byte 0x36 is nonzero.
consumer_ordering.record_notification: Clear bit 31 of the frame task word at 0x015b0ccc, then signal event 0x10 to that task. The flag service takes the kernel lock through 0x000439d8 (exclusive acquire, then barrier) and 0x00043a14 (barrier, store, synchronization barrier), which orders the clear before the signal and the waiter's recheck after it.
consumer_ordering.clear_record_release: Clear the record descriptor, then call the owned release.
consumer_ordering.boundaries: Whole ordinary Playback requirements initialization, second completion, reset, restart, timer cancellation, prefix preservation, submit, finish and cancel/restore are owned, as are develop job4, its record notification and clear-record release. The develop framework caller 0x00e936a8 and the overlay47 clear-record caller 0x01238160 remain outside this unit.
consumer_ordering.lifetime: The develop record and static request are constructed before reserved lock9 is acquired. In all three images the builder's only caller is job4 0x00e8ffe0 and job4's only caller is 0x00e93700; no literal pointer names any of the five entries. Construction runs only on task 0xb: subsystem 4 is set only by sender 0x00e92000 (payload word3 hard-coded 4; 0x00e9208c passes 0, 1 or 2 at all twelve call sites, other 0x1b-family senders hard-code 5), whose only caller 0x00e6e4fc sends static context 0x0157cc8c and operand 0x0157c458 to the triple 0x00e88584 copies from 0x00e8a540 (task 0xb recbkfrm1, loaded only at 0x00e87e84 and 0x00e88594). Task 0xb runs 0x00ea17d0, which completes 0x00e936a8/0x00e93700 before its next channel receive, and operand+8 0x0157c460 = 0xb makes frame task 0x015b0ccc the executing task. Image4 and overlays 44/46/47 hold no reference to these entries, 0x0157cc8c, 0x00e8a540 or 0x015b0ccc. The kernel wait accepts any current-task event 0x10; the owned job4 releases only after its record notification has run (event_0x10_dispositions). After a genuine completion it returns with record, IRQ token and resource cleared and lock9 signalled.

event_0x10_dispositions.kernel: Kernel0 0x000405d4..0x0004061c stores flag services +0x88 set 0x0004813c, +0x8c interrupt-context set 0x0004839c, +0x90 clear 0x000485c0 (pattern AND argument) and +0x9c wait 0x00048b30. In all five images only wrapper 0x00724558 loads +0x88/+0x8c; it signals the flag named by the low halfword of its task argument. 0x007243a8 OR-waits on the current task's flag; a satisfied wait clears the whole pattern only when the flag attribute has bit 2. 0x00725dd8 creates each task flag with attribute 4 unless creation descriptor +0x18 is 0xa5f0a5f0, and 0x00e922bc leaves that word (frame -0x20) unwritten for task 0xb.
event_0x10_dispositions.senders: 0x00724558 has 110 BL callers and one tail branch (0x00dac074). 47 pass a constant task other than 0xb (0x2, 0x5, 0x7, 0x1c, 0x22, 0x2f, 0x32, 0x48, 0x49, 0x53, 0x5d, 0x64, 0x68) and 33 pass bits without 0x10; neither can wake job4. 31 can deliver 0x10 to a task taken from RAM or arguments: job4's own notification 0x00e8eb30; cancel-all 0x00e937dc (all bits to context +0x34 while its operation slot is even 0xe2..0xf8); 20 single-operation completions 0x00dac074, 0x00db8a24, 0x00e4e4ec..0x00e4e73c, 0x00e58c48 and 0x00e63e60..0x00e63fcc, whose task words their waiters store from 0x00723cb8 (current task), every waiter except 0x00db8a24's being reachable from task 0xb entry 0x00ea17d0; waiter-table broadcasts 0x00e44d2c and 0x00e4606c; image4 0x006c1c8c/0x006c238c/0x006c31ac (task 0x0095e1ec, bits 0x0095e1f0); 0x00dc4db8 (halfword 0x014e59c8, bits argument); and 0x00e459d4, 0x00e46334, 0x00e46350 (task from locals or arguments). Bytes exclude none of the 29 foreign sites from task 0xb while a record is live.
event_0x10_dispositions.owned_behavior: A foreign wake leaves frame-task bit 31 set; owned job4 retains every event bit except 0x10, rechecks and waits again, so release follows the record notification. Stock job4 releases on any wake, before completion. A cancel-all delivered during job4 therefore no longer aborts a running decode; owned job4 returns after the decode's own completion or setup failure.
event_0x10_dispositions.overlay47_clear_record: 0x011f1ac4, 0x011f1b08 and 0x011f1c18 call 0x0123824c, whose only callee 0x01238160 cancels timer +0x6c and calls clear-record release only when byte 0x014febf9 is 1. In all five images the only resolved stores to that byte are the clear at 0x01238230 and memsets 0x01237a8c (0x1ec bytes) and 0x01238c5c (0x78 bytes) of block 0x014febd0; no store-multiple or register-offset store targets the block. The clear-record branch is unreachable within linear address propagation; dynamically supplied pointers are not excluded.

owned_device_services.native_boundary: Ordinary AAPCS service entries remain declared conditional native boundaries. Polling and MMIO acceptance execute against the pinned full-system JPEG model.
owned_device_services.ownership_limit: Owned transaction calls these definitions directly. Other retained channel9 callers are not globally redirected or retired.

retained_consumers: 0x00724558 task-event notify, 0x007243a8 current-task wait and 0x007246f0 current-task event retain
scope: Owned ordinary JPEG lifecycle and develop job4 consumers over the unchanged source/output and JPEG device interfaces. Twenty exact whole source entries publish forty actual words using ABI7 and the existing allocation. Native comparisons require independent stock execution. No cable/reset bit14 law, codec replacement, pixel tolerance, capture continuation or retirement/unload claim.
removal_obligations: Replace retained resource1e routing, reserved lock9, cache and IRQ registration services through their owning units.
Qualify and replace the retained command4 endpoint-reprogram service without inventing its device law.
Replace machine5/deferred-notification consumers through their owning units.
Replace the develop framework finish caller 0x00e936a8, the overlay47 clear-record caller 0x01238160 and the task-event notify/wait/retain services through their owning units.
Keep the static request, develop record and subscribers live through all retained callers.

Task 0xb's flag attribute (clear-on-wake) is undecided from bytes; a foreign 0x10 that lands after job4 has observed its notification stays latched for the next 0x10 waiter on task 0xb when that attribute is clear, as in stock.
Keep published IRQ entry executable through retained interrupt release; establish quiescence before any unload or removal.
Retain separate qualification for endpoint-reprogram command4 and device status bits17/24, which lack actual PLAY device execution.
